title: Integrate DXC in CMake and optionally enable DirectX 12 Agility SDK
purpose: Ensure DXR shaders compile with dxc.exe and allow opt-in to latest DX12 features via Agility SDK.

steps.detail: Add CMake logic to locate dxc.exe (VS, WinSDK, or environment). If unavailable, gate off DXR features.
Compile shaders/dxr/*.hlsl to .dxil using DXC: /T lib_6_3 /Zi (Debug) /Qstrip_debug (Release).
Document and optionally set D3D12SDKVersion=616 (or 717 preview) and D3D12SDKPath='D3D12\' for local runs. Copy D3D12Core.dll and d3d12SDKLayers.dll to that folder next to the exe.
At startup, log detected D3D12SDKVersion via D3D12GetInterface or environment to confirm Agility loading.

acceptance: DXC compiles DXR shader libs into .dxil artifacts
App logs Agility SDK version when enabled
DXR path gracefully disabled when DXC unavailable
